name: dual-tone-apply
description: Dual-tone 3D texturing for ChatGPT: halftone any grayscale or colour image to pure black/white, then box-project it over the whole STL/3MF part as an image texture and open an offline 3D editor to refine it (paint or flood-select triangles, move the projector, clear and start fresh).

interface.longDescription: Two skills that work together. Halftone-image intercepts any grayscale or colour image, opens an offline halftone viewer (dot and line screens, error diffusion, Bayer, blue noise, presets) and exports a 1-bit black/white PNG. Dual-tone-apply box-projects any black/white texture (image, QR code, text, logo, pattern or halftone) over the whole STL/3MF part, with no feature recognition, and opens a self-contained Three.js editor with paint / flood triangle selection, projector gimbal, a clear-texture button and adjusted-3MF export. The download also includes dual-tone-studio.html: an offline page that does all of this with no Python (pick a model and a picture, or open a 3MF): https://rw-g.github.io/dual-tone-plugin/dual-tone-studio.html
defaultPrompt: Put this logo on the front face of my STL and give me a 3MF.
Turn this photo into a halftone and wrap it around my cylinder.
Add a 30 mm QR code to the top of this part.
